g.text: (b) Energy per kg O₂, mare soil

Typical Apollo 16 and Apollo 11 soil oxides; 90 % of ilmenite reduced; reaction energy = enthalpy of formation of the reduced oxides (298 K). Process temperatures 1 300 K (H₂), 1 200 K (FFC), 1 900 K (molten);
fusion 0.48 MJ/kg. Real plants add electrical and thermal losses, and can recover much of the sensible heat.
